description: Gzar-dina de-Yeshu (Toledot Yeshu, JA1 in Bohak's edition, Judaeo–Arabic translation, "Pilate" recension), middle portion of the text containing passages 6.1–; read consecutively with T-S NS 298.55 (PGPID 41697) and London, BL Or. 6197.7–8 (PGPID 41699) as a single irregular quire.
